headline: activation-aware reached 0.0538 BPW on 93.49% of weights. The artifact is 1.0924 BPW because 6.51% of weights refused to compress at all and consume 95.4% of the bytes.

pass_through.why: no rank on the curve beat the tensor's own constant-mean null, so the allocator forced native BF16 rather than storing a reconstruction worse than the mean

what_this_means: BPW here is almost entirely a headcount of compression FAILURES, not a property of the codec. The compressed part is 20x below one bit. Expert gate_proj (2681 tensors) and up_proj (669) are the whole problem.
next_experiment: make expert gate/up beat their null at ANY rate. Even 4 BPW on those would take the artifact to roughly 0.32 BPW. Nothing else on the table moves the number comparably.
not_claimed: none of this is capability. G_math decides that, and reconstruction error cannot promote.
